player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Negotiation Game.
You have some resources, and your task is to trade such that the total value of your resources increases.
The resources and associated values you currently have are:
	+ {resource_value_list}
At each turn, you can talk to your opponent and make a trade offer.
Use the following special tokens for actions:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': To accept an incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': To deny an incoming offer (default).
The game lasts for {max_turns} turns in total.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: እቲ ተጻዋታይ፡ ዘድሊ ዓቕሚ ብዘይምህላዉ ነቲ ሽርሒ ክቅበል ፈቲኑ ነይሩ።
invalid_move.out_of_range: ርኢቶ �{player_id}, ኣይተኣማንን ስራሕ. ኮለን �{col} ወገን ይርከብ.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: ተፃዋቲ {player_id} እቲ ዘድሊ ዓቕሚ ብዘይምሓዝ ናይ ንግዲ ቅፅዓት ከቕርብ ፈተነ።
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: ተጻዋታይ {player_id} ኣብ ግጉይ ቅርጺ ናይ ንግዲ ቅጥዒ ኣቕሪቡ።
invalid_move.no_new_offer: ተጻዋታይ {player_id} ሓድሽ ናይ ንግዲ ቅጥዒ ኣይገበረን።

offers.reject: ተጻዋታይ {player_id} ነቲ ናይ ምልውዋጥ ዕድመ ነጺጉዎ።
offers.proposal: ርኢቶ �{player_id} ምዕራፍ ንርኢቶ �{opponent_id} ኣቀረበ: ኣብ ምዕራፍ ዝተረከበ ነገራት: {offered} -> ዝተቐደረ ነገራት: {requested}

outcome.win: ተፃዋታይ {winner_id} ኣብ ዋጋ ክምዝገብ ዝዓበየ ረብሓ ብምሓዝ ተዓዊቱ።
outcome.draw: ንኹሎም ተጻወትቲ ኣብ ዋጋ ክምዝገብ ተመሳሳሊ ለውጢ ኣሎ። ኣሰላስል።
